<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple intro (model intro@1): an optional badge, a large heading, a description and up to two links as the
  actions (the first primary, the second secondary, each drawn only when its label and its address are both
  set). Text only. Axes: place (middle: the copy in the middle of the section, bottom: low in a tall section,
  min-h-96).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type IntroSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  badge?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  secondaryActionLabel?: string;
  secondaryActionHref?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  place?: "middle" | "bottom";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  badge = "",
  title,
  description = "",
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  secondaryActionLabel = "",
  secondaryActionHref = "",
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  place = "middle",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<IntroSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="intro-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack
        gap="0"
        :align="column"
        :justify="(((place as string) === 'bottom') ? 'end' : 'center')"
        :class="(((place as string) === 'bottom') ? 'min-h-96' : '')"
      >
        <Stack gap="6" :align="column" class="w-full">
          <Badge v-if="badge" variant="secondary">
            {{ badge }}
          </Badge>
          <Title :as="level" size="5xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('max-w-4xl tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="lg" :class="cn('max-w-2xl text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
          <Group
            v-if="((actionLabel && actionHref) || (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref))"
            gap="4"
            align="center"
            :justify="column"
            class="flex-wrap"
          >
            <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
              {{ actionLabel }}
            </LinkButton>
            <LinkButton
              v-if="(secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref)"
              variant="secondary"
              size="lg"
              :href="urlOf(secondaryActionHref)"
            >
              {{ secondaryActionLabel }}
            </LinkButton>
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
